basic_details.job_title: CUJ Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: A Master’s degree with 55% marks in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university, along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. Degree. Alternatively, a Ph.D. degree from a foreign university with a ranking among the top 500 in World University Ranking.

qualification.details: Desirable Qualification: Specialization in Digital Media, Electronic Media, and Media Production.

how_to_apply: Complete online registration via the Google Form Link on or before 23 October 2026 up to 5:00 p.m.
Download the application form from the official university website.
Attend the Walk-In-Interview on 26 October 2026 with the filled application form, bio-data, all original documents, a set of self-attested photocopies, and two colour photographs.
Report for the interview between 9:30 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. at the Administrative (Block) Building, Central University of Jharkhand, Village: Cheri-Manatu, Kanke, Ranchi – 835222 (Jharkhand).

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice specifies 1 vacancy under the UR category for the Department of Mass Communication.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualification: Specialization in Digital Media, Electronic Media, and Media Production.

rows.qualification: A Master’s degree with 55% marks in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university, along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. Degree. Alternatively, a Ph.D. degree from a foreign university with a ranking among the top 500 in World University Ranking.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 57,700/- per month. The engagement is purely temporary in nature and initially for one semester, which may be extended based on University requirements and satisfactory performance. Incumbents are not entitled to residential accommodation, official transport, leave encashment, or other allowances admissible to regular employees, but are entitled to 8 days of leave on a pro-rata basis in a calendar year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUJ Assistant Professor (Temporary)
content_sections.text: Complete online registration via the Google Form Link on or before 23 October 2026 up to 5:00 p.m. Download the application form from the official university website . Attend the Walk-In-Interview on 26 October 2026 with the filled application form, bio-data, all original documents, a set of self-attested photocopies, and two colour photographs. Report for the interview between 9:30 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. at the Administrative (Block) Building, Central University of Jharkhand, Village: Cheri-Manatu, Kanke, Ranchi – 835222 (Jharkhand).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Filled downloaded application form Bio-data Original educational and category certificates Self-attested photocopies of all documents Two colour photographs Ph.D. compliance certificates (Annexure I or II, if applicable) Valid caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC in prescribed formats Annexure III and IV, if applicable) Medical certificate (for PH category claimants, if applicable)

faq.question: Q1. Is this post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary in nature, initially for one semester, and may be extended based on University requirements and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for a relaxation in marks?
faq.answer: A relaxation of 5% marks is provided at the Graduate and Master’s levels for SC, ST, Differently-abled, and OBC (Non-creamy layer) categories, as well as a 5% relaxation from 55% to 50% for Ph.D. degree holders who obtained their Master's degree prior to 19 September 1991.

faq.question: Q3. What is the deadline for online registration?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration is 23 October 2026 up to 5:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date and venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 26 October 2026, with reporting time from 9:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m., at the Administrative (Block) Building, Central University of Jharkhand, Village: Cheri-Manatu, Kanke, Ranchi – 835222 (Jharkhand).

faq.question: Q5. What are the desirable specializations for the Mass Communication post?
faq.answer: The desirable specializations are Digital Media, Electronic Media, and Media Production.
